verdict.rationale: Datadog's docs explicitly point AI agents to an /llms.txt documentation index and publish per-page markdown versions (API reference, OpenTelemetry, MCP server). A hands-on probe confirmed llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and describes itself as the canonical entry point to the docs. missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs effectively.
